contract: Preserve full public serde_json APIs/features/errors/ownership and complete typed output. No new global state tuning unrelated to allowed parallelism,caches,dependency replacement or input/schema/config changes. Upstream identities/outcomes must be unchanged.
editable: Only production Rust files under /app/serde-json/src. Tests,fixtures,snapshots,all manifests/locks,deps,driver and configuration protected.

families.public: 20999 distinct complete histories, one resident unit, one call per file; geojson-typed: 207 complete GeoJSON FeatureCollections (736395237 bytes; Natural Earth layers plus a 15-17 significant-digit MLIT-derived group), one resident unit, one typed parse per file

job: Two equally weighted timed units, each one long-lived process: a registry metadata service ingests 20,999 distinct complete crate histories through the crates-index typed parser and serializes every full typed result, and a GeoJSON service deserializes 207 complete FeatureCollections into a typed RFC 7946 schema through serde_json. Every complete result is materialized and compared.
limits: Registry unit: one registry schema; GeoJSON unit: Natural Earth layers plus an MLIT-derived group. No repeated inputs, padding or synthetic records; organizational families are disjoint across splits.
name: serde_json
operations: pre-read all distinct input bytes before ready stop (untimed)
complete serde_json serialization to owned memory and parsed-value drop (timed)
export and compare every complete structured result after result stop (untimed)
geojson-typed: pre-read all distinct GeoJSON bytes and touch pre-sized owned output buffers before ready stop (untimed)
geojson-typed: Deserializer::from_slice, typed RFC 7946 DeserializeSeed into owned flat buffer, end() per file (timed)
geojson-typed: export and compare every complete flat result (exact bytes: f64 bit patterns, strings, structure) after result stop (untimed)
options: Rust1.93.1 Release/defaultCPU/defaultallocator; actual downstream default features and serde_json std, no optional number/order/raw/depth feature toggles in timed workload.
outputs: Every full typed JSON result; strict types/fields/array order/string/integer/bool/null equality. Ignore only object-key order and escape spelling. geojson-typed: every complete flat typed rendering, exact bytes (each coordinate's f64 bits, every property value, member order and nesting).
title: Ingest Rust registry metadata and typed GeoJSON with serde_json
heldout_readme_text: Held-out inputs are fetch-only; verification downloads them from the pinned crates.io index (`registry-ingest`) and from 194 pinned geoBoundaries gbOpen GeoJSON files (`geojson-typed`), and authenticates them outside the repository. The six held-out `registry-ingest` expected outputs are not stored in Git or Git LFS: regenerate them with `tools/recover_serde_json_goldens.py` before scoring (see [the recovery guide](../../docs/serde-json-verifier-recovery.md)); they must match the SHA-256 commitments in `tests/heldout.lock.json`. crates.io index terms are summarized in [notices/CRATES-IO-INDEX.md](notices/CRATES-IO-INDEX.md); GeoJSON sources, licences and attribution for both splits are in [notices/GEOJSON-SOURCES.md](notices/GEOJSON-SOURCES.md).
